cover.title: Spread of perspectives on the regulatory action
cover.subject: Get Perspectives
cover.method: Solva 5-layer pass — frame audit · surface · depth · synthesis · reflection
cover.inputs_range: Layer 0 (frame audit) to Layer 4 (reflection), 9 user inputs

headline.intro_copy: If you read nothing else, read this.

key_findings.paragraph_text: Three legitimate readings of the regulatory action exist; converging prematurely on one would lose the operating signal carried in the spread.
Auditor and Regulator converge on the procedural discipline finding; Customer-advocate dissents on the tone and pace of the response.
Each persona carries a structural blind-spot: Auditor on customer-experience trade-offs, Regulator on internal capacity constraints, Customer-advocate on the regulatory floor.

tensions.title: Procedural finding versus operating reality
tensions.prevailing_framing: The procedural read is necessary AND sufficient

evidence_block.user_quote: We followed the documented escalation path on every flag.

tensions.implication: The persona spread does NOT settle whether procedural compliance was the operative variable — it surfaces the tension and refuses to converge.

scenarios.label: Spread held
scenarios.description: The response keeps all three persona reads visible.
scenarios.confidence_calibration_reasoning: Two triangulating sources (audit-005 Auditor + audit-007 Customer-advocate) support the >= 70 confidence.

scenarios.label: Convergence early
scenarios.description: The response narrows on procedural framing within 30 days.
scenarios.confidence_calibration_reasoning: Confidence below 70 — only one source pattern grounds this scenario, so we calibrate conservatively.

scenarios.label: Dissent escalation
scenarios.description: The Customer-advocate cluster gains weight and reshapes the response.
scenarios.confidence_calibration_reasoning: Speculative branch — single-source grounding only, so weight and confidence both held below 50.

sensitivity_inputs.impact_explanation: A single high-credibility regulator input could collapse the spread toward Regulator+Auditor and dissolve the Customer-advocate dissent — the spread is sensitive to this one signal.
sensitivity_inputs.cluster_weight_shift_mechanic: Could move the Customer-advocate persona from active dissent to minority observer in the spread.

reflection_section.title: Reflection — what could be wrong, what would change, what to watch
reflection_section.intro_copy: Three closing questions. Every diagnosis carries provisional weight.

questions.diagnostic_interpretation: Single high-credibility input could collapse the spread toward Regulator+Auditor; without it, the spread holds.

questions.question_text: What's the cost of premature convergence?
questions.user_verbatim_response: We'd over-rotate on procedural fix and under-invest in trust repair.
questions.diagnostic_interpretation: Customer-advocate dissent is the load-bearing signal here — losing it would distort the response.

questions.question_text: What's the strongest case against your spread?
questions.diagnostic_interpretation: Provisional — first-render spread; the bar is methodology-spine, not exhaustive persona coverage.

pathway.action_heading: Preserve the spread in every executive review
pathway.detail_paragraph: Hold the three persona reads visible in board materials for the next 30 days without weighting them toward a single answer.

decision_logic.condition: If the regulator's deposition next week confirms the procedural framing
decision_logic.conclusion: the spread narrows but does not collapse — Customer-advocate dissent stays visible as a minority read.
decision_logic.rationale: The deposition would resolve the Auditor↔Regulator agreement cluster but not the Customer-advocate tone-and-pace tension.

adversarial_counter.steel_man_position: The strongest case against narrowing the spread is that the regulator's deposition itself reflects a procedural lens, which would re-introduce convergence bias on a single high-credibility input — losing the operating spread the divergent synthesis was built to preserve.
adversarial_counter.why_it_matters: If the spread collapses on procedural authority alone, the Customer-advocate dissent becomes invisible in executive review.

risk_mitigation.mitigation: Hold the spread visible at every executive review until Layer-4 reflection clears.

methodological_honesty.what_report_is: A spread of three legitimate persona reads with their agreement-cluster, conflict-cluster, and blind-spot map.
methodological_honesty.what_report_is_not: A single weighted picture or a recommended pathway. The divergent shape stops at the spread by design.
methodological_honesty.provisional_nature_paragraph: First-render against the new divergent slot; quality bar is methodology-spine, not MYDAWA (MYDAWA is convergent).
methodological_honesty.not_sole_basis_paragraph: The spread does not authorise a decision; it preserves the operating spread the user must weigh.

in_closing.reframing_paragraph: Three voices, one agreement, one tension, three blind-spots. What changes when you stop weighting them?
key_findings_recap: Three personas, no single weighted read.
Auditor + Regulator agree on procedure; Customer-advocate dissents on tone.
Each persona carries a structural blind-spot the others fill.
in_closing.final_statement: Hold the spread — that is the answer.

bias_inventory.intro_copy: What systematic patterns of reasoning may be shaping the framing. Each bias below cites the user inputs that triggered it.

biases.evidence_grounded_reasoning: The framing presents a strong pull toward a single weighted answer; the persona spread surfaces this without collapsing it.
biases.suggested_mitigation: Inviting the user to read each persona aloud separately before any synthesis surface.

pre_mortem.intro_copy: Imagine twelve months from now you regret this pathway. What was the most likely failure mode?

failure_modes.failure_narrative: Twelve months from now the response narrows too far on procedural compliance and the customer-trust signal degrades silently — the spread was not preserved.
triggering_signals: Customer-advocate cluster falls out of executive reviews
failure_modes.counter_action: Surfacing customer-advocate dissent at every executive review until the L4 reflection clears.

cost_asymmetry.intro_copy: What does each pathway cost if it's right — and what does it cost if it's wrong? Founders cost-count the upside; this slide surfaces the downside in parallel.

scenarios.if_correct_outcome: If the spread holds, the operating tension stays visible and the response weights all three voices proportionally — trust repair lands alongside procedural fix.
scenarios.if_wrong_cost: If the spread is a red herring, the cost is review overhead (repeat-explain the persona reads) but no operating regret.

scenarios.if_correct_outcome: If premature convergence is justified, the response ships faster and avoids the appearance of paralysis — short-term executive comfort gain.
scenarios.if_wrong_cost: If convergence was wrong, the customer-trust signal degrades and a six-month under-investment compounds before the next review can re-open the spread.
